S1.scenario: User is logged out and cart is gone
S1.rootCause: Session expired after 30 minutes. Guide the user to sign in again.
S1.expectedMessage: Your session expired. Please sign in again to restore your cart.

S2.rootCause: The PAYMENT_KEY environment variable is missing or incorrect.
S2.expectedMessage: The payment service is not configured correctly. Please retry after checking the payment settings.

S3.scenario: The page spins forever and does not load
S3.rootCause: Upstream API timeout has been toggled on.
S3.expectedMessage: The service may be temporarily unavailable. Please retry in a moment and check your connection.

S4.scenario: Total is off by one cent on large orders
S4.rootCause: Rounding is applied to each line item instead of once to the final order total.
S4.expectedMessage: An issue with the order total calculation has been detected.

S5.scenario: Search returns duplicate items on page 2
S5.rootCause: Pagination offset is off by one, causing overlapping results.
S5.expectedMessage: A search pagination bug has been detected.
